title: Climate wins in 2025
voice: Every title, desc, comment or intro here is read by a player and is written as Envie speaking. See CLAUDE.md and _DESIGNS/envie-voice-and-text-rewrite-guide.md: plain short sentences, no em-dashes, European spelling, no emoji, facts and sources untouched. The optional 'envie' line on a slide is his own aside, one short sentence.

slides.text: 2025 was a year of political noise, rollbacks and broken promises in some corners of the world. But underneath it all, something remarkable was happening.
slides.envie: I went looking for the good news. There's more than you'd think.

slides.caption: of global electricity came from zero-emissions sources in 2025. A new record, and it happened in April, not at year end.
slides.envie: Records are nicer when they go this way.

slides.text: Ireland closed its last coal plant in June, becoming the 6th European country to leave coal behind entirely. France ran its grid 95% fossil-free for all of 2024.
For the first time ever, renewables produced more electricity than coal worldwide. Not in a target document. In actual electricity produced, in October 2025.
slides.envie: Ireland went coal-free the same year. Grand.

slides.caption: cars sold worldwide in 2025 was electric. In Norway, that number was 99 in 100.

slides.text: Global deforestation is falling. Brazil's Amazon hit its lowest deforestation rate in a decade. China has added 1 million hectares of wetlands since 2012.
slides.bold: lowest deforestation rate in a decade

slides.caption: of our oceans gained new protection when the High Seas Treaty entered into force in September 2025.
slides.envie: Half the planet is ocean. About time.

slides.text: China's CO2 emissions were flat or falling for 18 months in a row. Its clean energy sector grew to 10% of GDP, larger than its entire property sector.
slides.bold: flat or falling for 18 months in a row

slides.caption: of all new US energy jobs in 2024 came from clean energy, growing 3× faster than the rest of the workforce.

slides.text: None of this means the problem is solved. But the energy transition is no longer a plan. It's happening, faster than almost anyone predicted.
slides.envie: That's why I came down. It's moving.
